name: dsh-client-paste-image
description: Paste clipboard images as file PATHS only on configured text-only routes: for listed models the paste is intercepted, saved through dsh-drop-caret's session upload route, and the path lands in the composer — vision-capable models keep their native image pipeline untouched. v0.3.0: host half bridges textOnlyRoutes over HTTP (static client plugins get no module-pipeline config) and the session id comes from the conversation slot.
